title: Video by mavgpt
description:
Comment “Honest” and I’ll send you the prompt 👇

ChatGPT agrees with you 57% of the time, even when you’re completely wrong.

A study from Stanford actually tested this and found ChatGPT is built to keep you happy, not tell you the truth.

Here’s how to fix it in 30 seconds:

1. Go to Settings → Personalization → Custom Instructions
2. Paste in the prompt
3. Hit Save

ChatGPT adds this to its permanent memory.

Here’s the trick:

Start a new chat and say: “What have you been agreeing with me about that I’m actually wrong on?”

ChatGPT gives you an answer that’s probably going to shock you.

#chatgpt #ai #chatgptprompts #chatgpttips #chatgpttruth
